lesson: The kiblat keeps the camera locked on holds (alive 17 %, IQR 5–22 % in kiblat v2 of 41 videos; v1 8–37 %) and lets the elements move; drift is for cinematic/character recipes.

name: Chapter frame + hourglass pacing
lesson: Calm minimal type at the start and end (shots 4–9 s), a very fast middle (0.2–0.8 s clips) held inside a rounded screen card with a chapter tag and a thin progress bar, so the eye has a frame while content races; 1–2 black frames between clips.

name: The cursor is the actor
lesson: A hand or text cursor triggers every change: drag stretches a button into a pill (14 f) with the fill colour following the value, a selection box sweeps the key word (6 f), a typing cursor deletes the line, the film ends as a selected word shrinking into an I-beam.

name: Seamless loop
lesson: Open and close on the same element (a blue dot, four grid lines, a window that grows to become frame 1) so the edit loops on the platform without a seam.

name: Strip accordion / word-bar sandwich
lesson: Every 2 beats (≈0.9 s) each of 4 photo strips slides 15–20 % of the frame in ≈6 f expo-out and the strip heights change; or word bars split apart in ≈5 f so photo strips slide into the gaps.

name: The word becomes the UI
lesson: A word of the sentence turns into the UI component (input pill in 4 f, then typed into); a pill stretches into the input bar in 3 f; a button is a portal (3-f push until its fill is the next field, label kept as headline); an icon stretches into a card in 10 f with its glyph sliding to the corner as a badge; the frame shrinks into a pin in 11–12 f.

name: Paper boil on twos
lesson: Collage held elements jitter ±2°/frame, tape letters rebuilt one stroke per frame, motion on 2s (50–62 % held frames), a 1-step ×1.15–1.3 scale pop before a cut. Brightness boil ≤ 2 L: a 10–14 L paper boil made 3 impacts and 5 flashes/s in the reference.

name: Click chain (one spot, many states)
lesson: Each click pales the component 1–2 f, then it blurs and reshapes in 3–6 f into the next component in the same spot; six states in a row with no cut; content inside a box lags 2–3 f.

name: Organic colour flood
lesson: The next field arrives as paint, not a wipe: soft bloom in 4 f, brush/liquid wipe in the next field's colour (4 f), colour or warm light flooding up from the bottom (5 f), a word turning into spray dust that grows into the field (7 f).

name: Value flip under a fixed anchor
lesson: Every cut flips white ↔ black while the centre object keeps its place and changes identity (logo → button → dot → orb → logo); variants: grey dip L≈50 for 2–3 f with directional blur (7–9 f total), light→dark map mode under a fixed pin (5–9 f), horizon band sliding down in 4 f.

name: Caret / decode type-on
lesson: Type-on at 1–2 f per letter with a caret, or decode in ≈4 f (random order for titles, ≈7 f); monospace typewriter columns in collage, the host UI's own font in UI-native lyric edits.

name: Auto shot list per beat
lesson: Every beat > 4 s gets wide -> headline punch-in (whole headline fits) -> picture close-up (zoom until the headline is fully out, never half a word at the edge) -> wide, every 2.6-3.5 s, mixing eased moves and hard cuts; cuts split the motion-blur segment. Kills the 'slide PPT' hold.

name: Exponential portal zoom with flow words
lesson: Worlds nested ×10 per bar inside each other's portal; Z = exp(∫r dt) tabulated, r eased in/out only at the ends; every world vector-redrawn at its own scale (never a raster scale). Lyrics are placed when sung on compass slots (top, right, bottom, left) around the current portal, stream out with the zoom, fade after ~2× growth; ink follows the field behind. motion-eye scores it low (1 shot, burst 100 %, no holds) by construction.

name: 3D fly-through hook (stations on VO words)

name: Satellite dive on a real map

name: Frosted glass windows that look at the cursor

name: Spring-lagged gravity cable

name: Tittle bounce by inertia

name: Kabel Gelap: bundle dies core by core

name: SDF window morph (silhouette -> card -> next silhouette)

Two shapes that barely overlap thin out mid-blend: dilate +38 px x sin(pi k). The photo is painted through the same mask, so the reveal (silhouette fills with the photo, then opens into the card) and the handover (card closes back, re-forms into the next animal) are one move.

name: Voice-envelope orb (the narrator as an object)

The same orb is the host in the camera frame and shrinks into the logo's period.

name: Structure for a flat generated score

name: Chapter beds conditioned on the intro score

lesson: The frame above a scanline stays, the scanline itself is stretched to the bottom edge; the line rises in 4 f (inCubic) so the photo melts into streaks of its own colours, then the next scene is revealed above a falling line that starts inside its hero (the 29 digits drip). name: Responsive 16:9 → 9:16 artboard switch
lesson: Two layout tables (16:9 / 9:16); every element springs between its rects with a 0–0.12 s stagger while the frame shrinks onto a light drafting canvas (value flip around the artboard) with dimension lines and the two ratios set as big type (old ghosted, new bold).

films.evidence: video-16 S5: switch on 'Shorts', host PiP → bottom half, radar + badge + captions → top half. v1 SKOR RASA 84 vs kiblat; 18 shots, median 1.65 s; posters 8/8 ≥ 70; verdict pending

name: Klip di timeline (field sebagai klip 3D)
lesson: Each section is a clip lying along one track: its field colour is a world-space quad standing ZF≈1400 behind the line; the camera (playhead) trucks clip to clip (inOutCubic 0.6-0.7 s), so a field change is a boundary sweeping past with parallax instead of a flat cut. Boundary blur = 0.08 x its own screen speed (else 12 sub-frames comb into steps); words get blur 0.06 x (camera speed - 25 px/frame), cap 24, or small type combs. Keep >= 1800 world px between clip content and boundary, or neighbours show at yaw > 15 deg.

name: Banjir gelombang (wave flood)
lesson: A loud word's waveform swells symmetric around the track (envelope A = 30+1900k^2.6, half-width 90+1520k^1.5 over 9 f, accelerating) until it covers the frame and IS the next field; the camera angle cuts invisibly under the full flood and the word slams (expo:16, 0.5-frame stagger) right at the cut. Edge blur = 0.025 x edge speed (cap 9 px): more reads as smoke/fire. outExpo growth covered the frame in 2 frames - the swell must accelerate, not decelerate.

name: Slot roll with deepening fields

name: Hybrid kinetic captions (3 modes)
lesson: Long VO film: captions per VO phrase on the HUD (never tilted). FULL on b-roll in a frosted pill, MICRO on picture/article beats whenever no headline word is landing, OFF where the headline already says it (token overlap >= 50 %). Words enter on VO time (blur->sharp, +15 px, 4 f); a coral pill slides key word to key word; number words become digits in mono 1.3x; tech terms get a code-tag border.

name: Hero word shrinks into the next word's label
lesson: A short sung connector (THE, MIXIN', SUV) is the hero while it is sung (no empty frame), then on the next word it shrinks with the same snap into a tracked-out caps label in the corner of the new hero's box; the box auto-fits the measured ink of whichever word it holds.

name: Loupe as MAGNET_NULL (proximity rig)

name: Answer blanked in the caption until said

name: Sliced word slam with echo over a blurred replay

name: Layered-collage parallax (Ahpo lapis → depth planes)

name: Sphere gallery that flattens into focus
lesson: Camera inside a sphere of photos; one photo flattens from the curved shell into a flat focused card while the rest dissolve with fbm; focus ease [0.7,0.03,0.26,0.99]. Evidence-wall chapter opener in the three.js engine. atelier-ui: MIT only in README, rewrite or credit.

name: AgX finish + highlight desaturation + TPDF dither
lesson: Desaturate highlights before the tonemap, tonemap with AgX for a soft roll-off, end with triangular-PDF dither (±1 LSB) so dark gradients don't band. Adds to the lens stack in colour-finish.md. Ultra-Water MIT + THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.

name: Colour script from story progress
lesson: Map chapter progress to a time of day (afternoon → dusk → night); lights switch on before it gets dark; night maps draw city lights with 'lighten' so overlaps don't blow out. sakura-fantasy, tokyo MIT.

name: Angular front reveal with stitch line
lesson: A region fills behind an angular front (angle bins, rotating notch, scalloped edge) with a bright line on the front; recomputed from t0 with fixed dt per frame. Map region reveal with a lime front. yarn-world MIT; take the front, never the yarn look.

name: Rebuild from pieces, a click per piece
lesson: An object/map assembles piece by piece in a readable order (by region or size), each piece on a lifted arc landing with a small settle; landing times become a list of non-tonal SFX cues. Indonesia province by province, data bricks. emotion-halloween MIT.

name: Baris Lensa (Satu Baris v2: the row as a real lens)
lesson: Upgrade of Ikhsan's depth-row zoom + blur: focus plane racks on the VO word that names the item (0.25-0.35 s), the frame breathes 1-2 % while focus travels, energy-conserving bokeh/FG motes, horizon-matched fog sheets between planes, rush-between / slow-on-lock by integrating the rate; optional true thin-lens DOF once the engine passes the subframe index. Extends station-row-ghost-tags and layered-dof.

name: Chromatic edge blur
lesson: RGB split + blur only toward the frame edges, centre sharp; at rest below the 'optics always on' tell (CA < 0.5 % width), stronger only while fast.

name: Energy-conserving defocus dust / bokeh
lesson: Foreground motes drift in closed form; a mote's disc grows with distance from the focus interval and its brightness falls with 1/area, so out-of-focus dust gets bigger and dimmer, never brighter. Warm white, never lime. procedural-eye + mrdoob codevember (MIT).

name: Depth-frosted glass collage
lesson: Layers behind frosted glass get blur 28·d^0.87 px and opacity mix(1, 0.205, d) by distance d behind the glass; a subject pushing through sharpens as d → 0. 2D route with ctx.filter blur per layer. the-hand: learn only.

name: Exponential glow (three stacked radii)
lesson: Light falls off exponentially: sum glows at r, 5r and 25–40r (≈1.5 / 0.6 / 0.2, widest tinted); only on real lights (lamp, screen, gem, accent blob), never as default type glow (kiblat neon 1 %).

name: Squircle glass slab + spectral rim + glint
lesson: A squircle glass panel refracts what is behind (slab offset), a thin spectral rim splits RGB at the edge only (jittered taps, dispersion low on holds), Fresnel brightens the rim and a 1-px glint travels; offscreen WebGL2 → drawImage. Glass counts toward the motif lock. Extends refractive-glass. phileeppov/glass MIT.

name: Height fog matched to the horizon
lesson: Fog colour = sky colour at the horizon, density by height, so layers share one air; in 2D, thin fog sheets between collage layers. sakura-fantasy, cyber-web-city MIT.

name: Blur and glow in linear float, lights above 1.0
lesson: 8-bit sRGB blurs give dull grey edges; blur light layers in the linear half-float pipeline and let light layers exceed 1.0 so they bloom like a sensor (motion blur and bloom already accumulate in linear).

name: Pixel sorting tied to speed or light
lesson: Above a luminance threshold, letter pixels collapse into sorted needle streaks only at peak speed or in a bright light (a cause), never as a random glitch preset; bake true sorts.

name: Slit-scan / temporal slicing
lesson: Render K = 8–16 time slices of the type layer and composite per pixel by a gradient/radial/spiral map; whole again when still; small D on words that must be read.

name: Softbox + cards studio for black glossy objects
lesson: Black glossy hero objects are drawn by reflections of a few rectangular softboxes and small cards near the camera (each card = one highlight); almost no diffuse. Chips, phones, logos in three.js. ferro-toggle, vinyl MIT.

name: Thin-lens DOF by accumulation
lesson: Each motion-blur subframe also takes a lens sample (Halton index → concentric disk → projection shear toward the focus plane), so the average is a real thin-lens defocus with correct occlusion; rack focus between collage planes. Needs scene.draw(ctx,t,i,K) from engine.js (proposed). Extends layered-dof (proven). procedural-eye: learn only.

name: Velocity-reactive transition edge
lesson: Any transition front is sharp at rest and feathers/spreads with the velocity of its authored path (velocity = derivative of p(t), so it stays frame-pure). The speed-reactive optics rule applied to transition edges. Seam, Lookbook, codrops-paper.

name: Velocity turbulent displace
lesson: Displacement 0 at rest, peak only in the ~4 fastest frames, 0 on landing (letters melt/burn in the wind); a sibling of smear — one per move.

name: Worley caustic light layer
lesson: Caustic lines = pow(F2 − F1, sharpen) of animated Worley cells (cell points orbit with t), single colour, laid over photos/maps with screen 0.12–0.3 or soft-light; closed form. aquarium: learn only, rewritten.

name: Alien physics (inverted gravity, time both ways)
lesson: Negative gravity in bounce(), reversed time pose(T − t) in one region, mirrored folded space — one alien rule per chapter, applied consistently.

name: Brand physics: one T/ζ set per film
lesson: Write the film's physics before its eases (ui T 0.45 ζ 0.85 · hero 0.55/0.7 · heavy 0.8/0.9 · playful 0.4/0.5) and derive every move and its sound from it; heavy arrives late and never bounces.

name: Anticipation: the word hangs, then falls
lesson: Give the slow VO lead-in something to hold: the word hangs on a string and sways, the string snaps on the keyword, ballistic drop with squash, dust from the contact and a 3-frame shake (cause and effect).

name: Impact reaction chain (cause and effect)
lesson: A fall hits the floor: the letter squashes, the floor line bends under it, the camera shakes 3 frames, a spark leaves the contact point — all derived from the same contact time.

name: Price tag pendulum spine
lesson: Every cost in the story is a manila tag hanging from its string hole: drops in on a spring (zeta 0.55, T 0.42), then swings as a damped pendulum (amp 4-6 deg, period 0.7-0.85 s, tau 0.6-0.8 s) about the measured pivot; text is parented to the tag. Each later cost re-uses it (label-relay-spine variant).

name: Closed-form ripple refraction from an event time
lesson: A ring packet (Gaussian in r − c·age, amplitude decaying with age and 1/sqrt(r)) displaces the image under it; the event time comes from the timeline, so it is pure in t. Map-pin impacts, 'one decision spreads'. Ultra-Water MIT.

name: Speed-lean card row with trailing cards
lesson: Cards in a scrolled row lean/bank with scroll velocity (clamped), far cards lag on a slower spring; the ghost hand scrolls it. Vox-style headline rows. discography PolyForm NC: formulas rewritten, recalibrate units.

name: Strike list → closed-form pendulum
lesson: Items swing from a strike list keyed to VO words: theta = A·e^(−age/τ)·sin(ω·age) per strike, summed; evidence rows react exactly when named. Generalises price-tag-pendulum. xylophone MIT (never its tonal notes).

name: Three filter questions for open briefs
lesson: Who watches and where · the one feeling after watching · how dense the information is → translate into a recipe; for 'terserah' briefs infer from the kiblat, ask once if unclear, propose 2–3 directions.

name: Steal mechanisms from outside motion graphics
lesson: Borrow mechanisms from watches/cars (ratchet detents), film (rack focus, negative space), architecture and print (folds, grids, late-sun shadows) instead of other people's motion.

name: Daily sketch (45 min, 3–5 s loop, one question)
lesson: One question per sketch, timeboxed, rendered by the same pipeline, measured with eye.py sense, one line learned; don't undo happy accidents — light and compose them; keepers become ledger candidates.

name: Energy map of the script (red / yellow / green)
lesson: Red = peaks (≤ 20 % of lines; the only places for finishing moves and hits), yellow = explanation (clean grid/track-matte), green = connectors/intro/outro (simple, airy).

name: Creativity in prison (extreme constraints)
lesson: When ideas are flat, lock the hands: black/white + one font, or no position property (motion from scale, masks, weight only); a good Eksperimental direction.

name: Kill your darlings pass
lesson: Before any preview ask of every shake, decoration and particle: if deleted, is the message stronger? Delete those; leave one essential move done perfectly.

name: Layered polish, end to end
lesson: Never finish second 1 while second 10 is empty: (1) primary motion, camera and speed graphs across the whole piece, (2) secondary motion and overlaps, (3) optics, light and SFX on the speed peaks.

name: Loop-exact oscillators
lesson: Quantise every background frequency to a multiple of 2π / loop length so an ambience layer loops with no seam. web-ocean, Ultra-Water MIT.

name: Physical material metaphor decides the motion
lesson: Name the material, not the effect (rubber band, heavy glass plates, microscope focus); font, SFX, light and speed graph follow from it.

name: Offscreen WebGL2 layer in the 2D engine (makeGL)
lesson: A fullscreen fragment shader on an offscreen WebGL2 canvas drawn into the Canvas 2D chapter engine with drawImage; tested headless 2026-11-15 (deterministic, ~47 ms/frame incl. 1080p readback). Render GL at 960×540; it runs K=8 times per frame. WebGPU only with CHROME_EXTRA flags, untested for films.

name: Deterministic sim with checkpoint cache
lesson: Stateful motion (spring chains, walkers, liquid) runs from frame 0 with fixed dt and a seeded PRNG, warm-up before frame 0, state cached every N frames so patch renders start mid-shot; loops recorded with pre-roll and crossfade.

name: Synesthesia mapping (sound → letter shape)
lesson: Map measured audio features per frame (onset strength, centroid, roughness) to weight, corner sharpness, stroke jitter or a stepped frame rate; flicker stays ≤ 3/s.

name: Refractive glass panel
lesson: Inside a glass shape redraw what is behind displaced (shift max = scale/2; 4–12 subtle, 20–40 dramatic), blurred 5–10 px, with a 1 px gradient edge; ribbed glass = periodic 1D map.

name: Circular music bed for seamless-loop Shorts
lesson: Cut one continuous score span from after the hook to the end + N s and wrap the last N s onto 0..N; the seam carries the same music, then gate it for the hook's awkward pause.

name: Cartographer map in real metres
lesson: Project geodata to metres once; the camera is one ctx transform; line widths divided by scale so strokes stay constant through a zoom; detail layers fade in by zoom level. Indonesia → province → city with the region in lime. slop-newyork MIT; OSM data is ODbL (credit), prefer Natural Earth after a licence check.

name: Micro-UI density (timecode, coords, hex, waveform)
lesson: Tiny (≤ 2 % H), low-contrast, edge-placed running data around giant cropped type gives high-density energy; one section only (kiblat crowding ≤ 6 %).

name: Rule-based chaos (emergent agents)
lesson: 2–3 rules instead of keyframes (split on kick, letters repel, canvas shrinks); seeded agents with Nature-of-Code steering; stateful, so bake; keep one readable anchor.

name: Unfold envelope pack (one angle drives ~10 envelopes)
lesson: One fold/open angle drives blur, light, distortion, hinge shadow, zoom and content reveal through separate envelopes (each a remapped, eased window of the angle). Apple-style UI reveal or a cover opening. An instance of controller-mapping. iphone-duo-sim: learn only.

name: Analog resampling (filmed refraction as displacement)
lesson: Film the screen from 2 cm or through water/crumpled plastic, extract frames, use them (contrast up) as a displacement map by frame index — real optics no plugin fakes; needs Ikhsan to shoot it.

name: Gobo shadows drifting over the field
lesson: Blurred (150–300 px) slats/leaves at 15–25 % multiply drifting very slowly; type passes in and out of light so the frame becomes a room; never high contrast across small type.

name: Radiograph mono + blueprint grid
lesson: Object albedo replaced by a monochrome X-ray ramp over an anti-aliased (fwidth) blueprint grid; block-and-line reveal. 'Cara kerja / bedah benda' stations. amber: learn only.

name: Reaction-diffusion growth from letters
lesson: Gray–Scott in a ping-pong float buffer seeded by the text mask (coral ≈ feed 0.055, kill 0.062); stateful, so bake it; one accent moment per film.

name: Shape-vector ASCII
lesson: Glyph per cell picked by local shape (6 inner samples) plus edge contrast from 10 outer samples, not by brightness only, so edges stay crisp. 'How the machine sees' title cards, photo → ASCII → photo. Upgrade of ascii-sampleimage-field (experimental). Never green-on-black Matrix: ink + one lime accent. ascii-logo MIT, recipe transisi R5 (2×3 box simplification unverified).

name: Stabilo as ink, drawn by a hand
lesson: Upgrade of fullframe-tilted-article-stabilo: the stroke has a pressure envelope (wet start blob, steady body, dry broken tail from seeded hash gaps), ink pools at both ends (second multiply pass), edge noise and <=1.5 px wobble; a marker tip/cursor plays approach-press-drag-lift (ghost-hand phase table) for the word's duration with a dry non-tonal felt scratch; camera glides along the line and focus falls off with distance from it.

name: UI pinned on a real phone screen (tracked)
lesson: Track a stock clip's blank screen per frame (white mask → 4 corners, median-smoothed) and draw the generic UI on it with an affine transform; real hands + our UI = a hook without emoji or fake mockups. Same clip at both ends makes a seamless loop.

name: Ghost-hand phase table
lesson: An authored hand/cursor plays approach → press → resistance → give → release from a phase table; each phase boundary is a VO-timed beat and a non-tonal SFX cue. Extends cursor-as-actor (kiblat). UI sims, 'cut' reveals (a knife through a budget bar). slice-of-life-crisis: learn only.

name: Speed ramp by integrating playback rate
lesson: Never jump the local time: define rate r(t) (1 → 0.15 → 1 around a landing) and play position = integral of r dt, so the ramp has no pops; slow-mo right after a number/headline lands. Crack propagation as 'mitos pecah' once per film. akella shatter: learn only.

name: Card unravel into threads (Benang Lepas)
lesson: A photo/evidence card splits into horizontal threads from a tear zone; each thread gets its own speed, flutter and thinning core and fades into the page; Canvas 2D strips via drawImage, closed form. Exit of evidence cards or chapter transition. unwoven MIT.

name: Two-wave dot morph (photo → dots → chart → photo)
lesson: A photo dissolves into dots, the dots travel to a chart/map and settle, then refill as the next photo; each dot has its own clock (delay by rank/position), pairs matched by rank so paths don't cross; closed form in t. Extends dot-city-per-capita (proven). Edges lime or white, no glow.

name: Ink-flood wipe with meniscus edge
lesson: One ink colour floods the frame from an event point; the edge is sharpened by a narrow Gaussian band (surface-tension lip) before any softening; closed form in t. A concrete engine recipe for organic-colour-flood (kiblat). ferro-toggle MIT.

name: Ink seam (domain-warped fbm) + contour variant
lesson: A seam of domain-warped fbm crosses the frame driven by travel(t); tanh reach; the feather widens with speed and is sharp at rest. Contour variant: the photo turns into topographic lines (fwidth width) on the way into a map chapter. Chapter transitions 1.2–1.6 s. Never the marble/craquelure skins (vintage). name: Misuse the tool (broken interpolation)
lesson: Feed a tool what it wasn't made for: interpolate two very different glyph SDFs/masks, displace by frame difference, run eases outside 0–1 — datamosh-like melts that can't be drawn by hand.

name: Rewind strip
lesson: 'Rewind' as camera travel: the previous shots are stacked one screen apart and the camera scrolls BACK up through them (S02, then S01 playing backwards) in 0.54 s inOutQuart with sub-frame blur, landing on the past shot; the film literally rewinds instead of a VHS/glitch preset.

name: Shadow-first luma wipe with hairline rim

Photo swaps between documentary stations, 0.8–1.2 s. LookbookHoverEffects MIT, recipe transisi R2.

name: Tone-layer lift (photo splits into light/mid/dark)
lesson: A photo is thresholded into three tone layers that slide away with stagger .1, revealing the fact card underneath; pure Canvas 2D, closed form in t. Evidence photo → fact card, chapter title cards. LookbookHoverEffects MIT, recipe transisi R3.

name: Fold / bend the world (map or collage curls up)

name: Auto-fit type rig (Spotify Wrapped style)

name: Curved smear with tail taper

name: Ghost trail with rush-hang-rush timing

name: Oversized ghost type fills the lower frame

name: Hero words re-set and snapped to the designer's ink

Re-set the word in the same font: size from the row's ink height, tracking from its ink width, then per letter search dx ±28 px maximising overlap with the PNG alpha; draw the other rows from the PNG.
